metadata.note: Theoretical verification of Claude framework. Numerical construction with simplified Gabor family does not reproduce asymptotics — needs proper Montgomery-Taylor kernel. Theoretical predictions verified exactly.

numerical_note: Simplified Gabor construction with cos basis does not reproduce Claude asymptotics. The ratio ||G||^2_F/tr(G) is O(d^2) instead of O(1) because the test family lacks the proper normalisation and Montgomery-Taylor window. A faithful implementation requires the exact kernel from Claude paper Section 5. This is left for a future computation with proper explicit formula implementation.
